## What This Is

Three governance additions that close common drift patterns: releases that ship with personal language still in them, useful external patterns that get surveyed once and forgotten, and session corrections that get lost when closeout doesn't happen.

None of these are complex. All of them are the kind of thing you think you'll remember and don't.

## What It Adds / Changes

**Release Hygiene Protocol** (`Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Release Hygiene Protocol.md`):
Seven standing rules for any personal-to-public release. Covers export-truth audits, two-tier publish gates (Blockers vs Improvements), the allowed-public-identity rule, public-safe automation checklists, repo-health baselines, encoding-repair fallback, and connective-tissue audits. Load this protocol before any publish review.

**Sovereign Tech Watch Protocol** (`Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Sovereign Tech Watch Protocol.md`):
A lightweight, Sovereign-triggered watch loop for GitHub repos and long-horizon infrastructure ideas. Includes a starter list of six Claude Code and Obsidian repos worth tracking. Paired with a deferred items tracker — when a pattern is ready, all the context needed to act is already in the file.

**Deferred Items Template** (`Council Chamber/Tools/Support Files/sovereign-deferred-items.md`):
The companion file for the Tech Watch Protocol. Four statuses: deferred, proposed, permanent-hold, retired. Add your first item when you run your first Tech Watch session.

**Continuity Log — Immediate Capture Rule** (`Council Chamber/AI Interface/Continuity Log.md`):
Standing entry added: capture corrections at the moment they occur, not at closeout. If the Sovereign corrects a behavior during a session, log it immediately. Waiting until closeout risks losing it. Same principle applies at the skill level — the Refinements section in each SKILL.md accumulates organically, never in bulk.

## How to Implement

1. Copy `Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Release Hygiene Protocol.md` into your vault.
2. Copy `Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Sovereign Tech Watch Protocol.md` into your vault.
3. Create `Council Chamber/Tools/Support Files/` in your vault and copy `sovereign-deferred-items.md` there.
4. Add the Immediate Capture Rule entry to your `Council Chamber/AI Interface/Continuity Log.md` under `## Active`.
5. Optional: add `trigger_phrase: "Release Hygiene Protocol"` and `trigger_phrase: "Sovereign Tech Watch"` to your `.claude/CLAUDE.md` so your AI loads each on request.

## Prerequisites

None. These are standalone governance additions. The Tech Watch Protocol pairs naturally with the Playwright skill (v1.4.0) for automated repo checks.

## Optional?

No — these cover release safety, pattern hygiene, and correction continuity. All three address drift that compounds silently.
